scope: Original official AE table; image/filter/compositing/optics/color/mask/keying responsibility. No completion inferred from export counts.

ownershipBasis.image: Agent-3: image filters, optics, color, channels, textures, masks, mattes, keying and pixel compositing.
ownershipBasis.time: Standing user allocation: Agent-2 owns text, paths, time and animation semantics. Existing Native time/motion/transitions are indexed read-only; not reimplemented or counted as Agent-3 delivery.
ownershipBasis.spatial: Standing user allocation: Agent-4 owns particles, physics, Puppet, spatial simulation/geometry and scene rendering.
ownershipBasis.publication: Main owns public entry, immutable package identity, SDK pin and distribution.
